insights.one_liner: US surgical device maker with its European HQ and manufacturing in Amersfoort, a recognised visa sponsor with an English-language project role.

culture.text: Designs and makes surgical devices in-house, at its California headquarters and its European headquarters in Amersfoort.
Spends on average 20% of revenue on product development and manufacturing efficiency projects.
About 4,063 people on LinkedIn; says it values open communication across all levels and departments.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Applied Medical Europe B.V.
Its one current opening, a mid-level product and project role in Amersfoort, does not ask for Dutch and drew around 174 LinkedIn applicants.

worth_knowing.text: After winning an antitrust case against Medtronic in the US, Applied Medical is seeking a permanent injunction.
